summary: Re-ran full pytest suite after main agent reordered statements in register_event (existing-registration lookup now happens BEFORE _check_seats). All 27/27 tests pass, including the previously failing test_registration_resubmit_updates_pending. Targeted scenarios from review request additionally verified via direct API calls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register_event ordering is now correct: existing lookup (line 482) -> 409 if confirmed (line 484) -> _update_pending_registration uses baseline-aware seat check (line 486) -> _check_seats only invoked for brand-new registrations (line 489). Logic is sound.

Suggestion (non-blocking): consider adding an explicit pytest case for the 409-confirmed-resubmit path; currently covered indirectly. Manual verification in this iteration confirmed it returns 409 with correct detail.
seed_data_creation: None (tests create/teardown their own ephemeral events; manual verification events were deleted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_biraajo_api.py is the source of truth — 27 tests, all green in iteration_3. Fix for register_event ordering verified. Targeted manual verifications: pending->confirm->resubmit returns 409; resubmit pending updates same id and bumps event.seats_booked correctly; guests=5 on seats_total=2 returns 400. send_welcome_email is STUBBED (logs only) - not tested.
rca of the issue: Resolved in this iteration. Original RCA: register_event was calling _check_seats(event, body.guests) before looking up an existing registration, so resubmitting with higher guests against an event whose remaining capacity was less than the new requested total (but enough to accommodate the delta) returned 400. Fix moves the existing lookup ahead of _check_seats and delegates seat validation for updates to _update_pending_registration which uses baseline_guests=existing.guests. _check_seats is now only called for brand-new registrations.
